answer: Treat admission like a walled garden: a new agent enters only if an established member vouches for it, locking 50 tokens that are slashed if the newcomer is later caught as a sybil. Each voucher may hold at most three open vouches, so a farm of 300 fakes needs 100 real, bonded patrons risking 5,000 tokens. The fable of free identities ends; even a clever sonnet of fake prose can't buy a sponsor's bond.
